Start the Lumen OS trial?
The trial is saved as files in the memory of the projector. The XGIMI system is not changed. After the restart Lumen OS starts once. The restart after that goes back to the XGIMI system.
To keep Lumen OS, choose Install inside the trial.
This version of Lumen OS cannot install itself from the trial yet. To keep it, use the computer installer from the guide.
Remove the trial?
The trial files are deleted and the space is free again. The XGIMI system is not changed.

What happens
Lumen OS starts once as a trial run, from files in the memory of the projector. Your XGIMI system and your files stay as they are.
Inside the trial you can choose Install to keep Lumen OS. Only that step erases everything on the projector, once, and it asks you first.
The installer checks that every Lumen OS file really comes from the Lumen OS project before it uses it.
How to go back
During the trial just restart the projector. It goes back to the XGIMI system.
Remove the trial here to free the space again.
After an install, the XGIMI recovery USB stick for this model brings the XGIMI system back. The guide on the project page shows how.
